claims.claim: Neat UK used Canon 800D with 18-55mm lens
claims.evidence: Witness photos show a black Canon DSLR with top Canon logo and body marking reading “EOS 800” (partially visible). The lens model/specs (e.g., 18-55mm) and whether it is included are not shown clearly, and “UK used” is not verifiable from the photos.

risks.risk: Model mismatch risk: photos read “EOS 800” (partially visible) but seller says “800D”; could be a different Canon variant or a misread marking.
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the full model name on the body (e.g., “EOS 800D” or exact model text) and the camera’s menu “About” screen showing the model.
risks.if_unproven: Price as the worst-case unidentified/possibly different Canon DSLR body with unknown exact model.

risks.risk: Lens not confirmed: seller claims an 18-55mm kit lens, but witness photos do not show the lens model/focal length markings clearly.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the lens front ring and side barrel showing the exact lens model (e.g., “18-55mm”) and mount/serial markings.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a body-only or as a generic/unknown lens kit with no confirmed focal length.

risks.risk: Missing essentials: battery, charger, cables, strap, caps, and memory card are not shown.
risks.proof: Photos showing all included items laid out (battery, charger, strap, lens caps/hood, USB cable if any, and memory card).
risks.if_unproven: Price as incomplete kit (no charger/battery/memory), requiring buyer to source missing parts.

risks.risk: Condition and wear: scratches, dents, rubber degradation, and internal issues are not clearly visible.
risks.proof: High-resolution photos of corners, screen edges, grip rubber, lens mount area, and a video showing the camera powering on and controls responding.
risks.if_unproven: Price at worst-case cosmetic/operational condition (as-is, untested).

risks.risk: Sensor health: dust, scratches, fungus, or haze are not assessable from the provided shots.
risks.proof: A test shot of a blank white wall at a high f-stop (e.g., f/16) plus a close-up photo of the sensor area (mirror up) if possible.
risks.if_unproven: Price as potential sensor contamination (reduced value due to possible cleaning/repair).

risks.risk: Functionality not tested: autofocus accuracy, shutter count/usage, and LCD/viewfinder clarity are not proven.
risks.proof: A short video capturing autofocus on a moving subject and a photo of the shutter count/usage screen (or EXIF/shutter count readout if available).
risks.if_unproven: Price as unverified working condition (worst-case for shutter/AF performance).

proof_requests: Clear close-up photo of the full camera model text on the body (confirm exact “EOS 800D” vs other).
Close-up photos of the lens barrel showing the exact lens model/specs (confirm 18-55mm).
Photos of all included accessories: battery, charger, strap, lens caps/hood, USB cable (if any), and memory card.
A short video showing the camera powering on, focusing, and taking a photo (LCD and viewfinder working).
A sensor test image (white wall at high f-stop) to check dust/fungus/scratches.
response.reason: The witness report clearly identifies a Canon DSLR body with “EOS 800” marking, so it can be priced at its worst-case as an unverified kit. However, lens model, included accessories, and condition/function are not fully proven from the photos, so the price should reflect those uncertainties.
